On this week's Jeopardy, the first contestant was a chemist, the second contestant was a parking attendant, and the third contestant's profession wasn't revealed. The parking attendant quickly outpaced both of the other contestants, and the chemist did the worst, only getting two questions right. Who lost Jeopardy?
A. The parking attendant
B. The chemist
C. Not answerable
